definitions.gloss: top floor; highest floor of a building
definitions.explanation: The highest floor of a building. Common in property listings, hotel descriptions, and directions inside department stores.

examples.japanese: {最上階|さいじょうかい}に{住|す}んでいる。
examples.english: I live on the top floor.

examples.japanese: {最上階|さいじょうかい}のレストランは{景色|けしき}がいい。
examples.english: The restaurant on the top floor has a good view.

examples.japanese: このマンションは{最上階|さいじょうかい}だけ{天井|てんじょう}が{高|たか}く、{家賃|やちん}も{少|すこ}し{高|たか}い。
examples.english: In this apartment building only the top floor has high ceilings, and the rent is a little higher too.

notes:
From {最|さい} (most) + {上|じょう} (upper) + {階|かい} (floor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最上階|さいじょうかい}の{部屋|へや}: a top-floor room
- {最上階|さいじょうかい}まで{上|あ}がる: to go up to the top floor
- ビルの{最上階|さいじょうかい}: the top floor of the building

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {屋上|おくじょう}: rooftop — the open roof above the top floor, not a floor with rooms
- {最下階|さいかかい}: bottom floor — the opposite, though {一階|いっかい} or {地下|ちか} is more usual in speech
